evidenceAudit.scope: Adults 18 and over: which vaccines to offer by age, pregnancy and risk, catch-up for missed doses, and true contraindications. Verified against the Saudi PHA Clinical Preventive Guideline 2023 (adult checklist and Table 2), the UK Green Book Chapter 6 and UKHSA catch-up principles.
findings: Every dose, threshold and timing was checked against the cited source section on 12 Oct 2026.
Normal values are typical adult reference ranges; laboratories differ.
unverifiedSections: Current Hajj/Umrah and seasonal requirements not reproduced
PPSV23 timing references PCV13; newer PCV products may change sequencing

pathophysiology.summary: Immunity from childhood vaccines wanes (tetanus, pertussis) and new risks arise with age, pregnancy and chronic disease (influenza, pneumococcus, shingles). An adult vaccination review closes gaps and adds age- and risk-based vaccines.
keyMechanisms: Boosters restore waning antibody levels (Td every 10 years).
Ageing immune systems increase risk from influenza, pneumococcus and zoster reactivation.
Maternal Tdap in pregnancy passes antibodies that protect the newborn against pertussis.

symptoms: Review vaccination record, age, pregnancy, chronic disease and immunosuppression.
redFlags: Pregnancy or immunosuppression — no live vaccines (Green Book Ch. 6)
precipitants: Chronic heart, lung, kidney, liver disease; diabetes

ruleIn.normalValue: Up to date for age and risk (PHA Table 2)

clinicalManagement.title: Routine for all adults (PHA Table 2)
actions: Tdap once, then Td booster every 10 years.
Tdap in each pregnancy between 27 and 36 weeks.

clinicalManagement.title: By age
actions: 50 or over: herpes zoster, 2 doses 2–6 months apart.
65 or over: PCV 1 dose, then PPSV23 1 dose 1 year after PCV13.

clinicalManagement.title: By risk or immunity
actions: MMR: unvaccinated, premarital and postnatal women without immunity (1 or 2 doses by indication).
Varicella: no immunity — 2 doses 8 weeks apart.
Hepatitis B: no immunity — 3 doses at 0, 1 and 6 months.
HPV: catch-up for females 15–26, 3 doses at 0, 1–2 and 6 months.
PCV: adults with comorbid or immunocompromised conditions.
MCV4: 1 dose by indication; booster every 5 years if risk remains.

clinicalManagement.title: Contraindications
actions: Avoid after confirmed anaphylaxis to a previous dose or component; no live vaccines in pregnancy or significant immunosuppression (Green Book Ch. 6).
Live vaccines delayed 3 months after high-dose steroids (over 40 mg prednisolone daily for more than 1 week) (Green Book Ch. 6).

learningObjectives: Review and update adult vaccinations by age, pregnancy and risk.
